task.title: Host: pty_open_command and pty_tail with Rust tests and TS wrappers
task.description: In the Keryx Desktop Tauri host add two commands. (1) `pty_open_command(cwd, command, title, cols, rows) -> PtyTab`: a terminal tab whose process is the user's login shell running exactly one command — argv `[<shell>, "-l", "-i", "-c", <command>]`, where <shell> is resolved exactly as ordinary shell tabs resolve it (`pty.rs`, the user's shell from the login environment, `/bin/zsh` otherwise). It must behave like `pty_open_run` in every other way: same login-shell environment and TERM vars, same SIGHUP-then-SIGKILL close, `panel://pty-exit {id, code}` emitted to the window when the process ends whether or not the tab is on screen, a start failure is an error and leaves no tab. Owner `user`. Refuse an empty/whitespace-only command and a command containing NUL with an error string. (2) `pty_tail(id, lines) -> String`: the last `lines` lines (clamp 1..=2000) of the tab's kept output as plain text — reuse `plain_text` and `tail_lines` (you may move `tail_lines` from `panel_mcp.rs` into `pty.rs` and import it back; do not change `panel_mcp.rs` behaviour). It must work after the process exited, until the tab is closed. Register both commands in the Tauri invoke handler next to `pty_open_run`. Add typed wrappers `ptyOpenCommand(cwd, command, title, cols, rows)` and `ptyTail(id, lines)` in `apps/desktop/src/platform/panels.ts` next to `ptyOpenRun`. Write the Rust tests first (tdd-workflow); every new test name contains `run_command` so `cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml run_command` selects them: a command runs through the shell and its exit code is reported (`exit 3` -> Some(3)); shell syntax works (`echo a && echo b` prints both lines); the tail returns the last N plain-text lines with escape sequences removed, also after exit; an empty command is refused. Follow the existing pty.rs test style (e.g. `a_program_runs_directly_with_its_title_and_reports_its_exit_code`).

acceptance_criteria: AC2: The host command `pty_open_command(cwd, command, title, cols, rows)` runs `<login shell> -l -i -c <command>` in the project root with a shell tab's login environment, the command's exit code arrives as `panel://pty-exit {id, code}`, and `pty_tail(id, lines)` returns the last `lines` lines of the tab's output as plain text with escape sequences removed. [verify: exec `cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml run_command`]
